note: Font sizes, line heights and families the WinUI app still sets itself instead of through AppText (TextSize, TextLineHeight, TextHeight, TextFont), per file of scripts/check-design-tokens.js section 3, so they do not follow Settings › General › 글자. Counts only go down; lower them with node scripts/check-design-tokens.js --write. Exempt files are not counted; each says why, and a glob that matches no file fails.

exemptFiles.native/windows/MightyClaude.WinUI/AppTex: Where the text setting becomes FontSize, LineHeight and FontFamily: the one place they are written.
exemptFiles.native/windows/MightyClaude.WinUI/*Smoke: The Windows GUI smoke (--smoke-test): fixtures and measured expectations, not app chrome.
exemptFiles.native/windows/MightyClaude.WinUI/Screen: A fixed reference scene for the screen-share check, not app chrome.
